description: Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-by-tracking-code.spec.ts) against the deployed app and live DB: file a record with a randomUUID-suffixed tracking code at /stock/new, navigate to route /, type the code into lookup-input and click lookup-submit, and lookup-result shows its SKU, location, tracking code and quantity in lookup-result-sku/-location/-tracking-code/-quantity

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-deep-link.spec.ts): opening route /?code=<randomUUID-suffixed filed code> in the real app prefills lookup-input and shows the matching lookup-result without a full page reload

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-latency.spec.ts) against live API: after filing a record with a randomUUID-suffixed code, pressing Enter in lookup-input at route / makes lookup-result visible within about 200ms of the scan

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-not-found.spec.ts) against live DB: submitting a never-filed randomUUID-suffixed code U in lookup-input at route / shows lookup-not-found reading 'No record found for U' with no error page

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-not-tracked.spec.ts) against live DB: file a record via /stock/new with par level, batch and serial blank under a randomUUID-suffixed code, look it up at route /, and lookup-result-par-level, lookup-result-batch and lookup-result-serial each show 'not tracked'
